source: Dedicated Spanish practice requested by the learner
summary: Eight sentence attempts. Initial 30% prompt answered with 50%; descuente and de corrected to descuento and del. Later del retained throughout and complete 50% sentence correct. Veinta corrected to veinte, retained after a price interruption; descuente recurred once before two correct descuento uses. Price 180 fully correct after a gap. Seisciento corrected to seiscientos, retained in 1670; setanta corrected to setenta. Final 30% sentence needed treinte → treinta. Within-session improvements are not mastery.

observations.prompt: The discount is 30%. Spell out the number.
observations.learnerText: el descuente es de cincuenta por ciento
observations.correctedText: El descuento es del treinta por ciento.
observations.feedback: Cincuenta correctly spells 50 but differs from requested 30; descuento spelling and del = de + el corrected.

observations.learnerText: El descuento es del veinta por ciento
observations.correctedText: El descuento es del veinte por ciento.
observations.feedback: Descuento and del correct immediately after feedback. Veinta needed veinte, ending in e.

observations.prompt: The price is 180 euros. Spell out the number.
observations.learnerText: el precio es de ciento ochenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de ciento ochenta euros.
observations.feedback: Complete sentence correct without a fresh model; ciento appropriate for 180. Punctuation and initial capitalization supplied.

observations.prompt: The discount is 20%. Spell out the number again.
observations.learnerText: el descuente es del veinte por ciento
observations.correctedText: El descuento es del veinte por ciento.
observations.feedback: Del and corrected veinte retained after price practice. Descuente recurred; descuento ending in o supplied.

observations.learnerText: el descuento es del cincuenta por ciento
observations.correctedText: El descuento es del cincuenta por ciento.
observations.feedback: All requested words and grammar correct after prior feedback; punctuation and initial capitalization supplied.

observations.prompt: The price is 650 euros. Spell out the number.
observations.learnerText: El precio es de seisciento cincuenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de seiscientos cincuenta euros.
observations.feedback: Final s in seiscientos needed correction; other words and structure correct.

observations.prompt: The price is 1670 euros. Spell out the number.
observations.learnerText: El precio es de mil seiscientos setanta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de mil seiscientos setenta euros.
observations.feedback: Mil and corrected seiscientos retained. Setanta needed setenta.

observations.prompt: The discount is 30%. Spell out the number.
observations.learnerText: el descuento es del treinte por ciento
observations.correctedText: El descuento es del treinta por ciento.
observations.feedback: Descuento and del retained after intervening price practice; treinte needed treinta ending in a.

nextSteps: Recall veinte ending in e versus treinta ending in a after a gap.
Recall full discount sentence, including descuento ending in o and del.
Revisit seiscientos final s and setenta spelling after a gap.
Retain successful delayed ciento ochenta recall; do not infer general number mastery.
assessmentNote: Eight observed attempts, two entirely correct sentences. Successful components and recurring spelling corrections retained separately; no unattempted prompt recorded.
